content: Yecho ndi lighanga lina ughome
Yene mughalekengane ghanganandela ghoha na uwange na kukitenda maumbone, wiho na malobhe gha maligho ghakoto kubhehe kabhele.
Ngita chibhii yana ilemba chibhapala mabhele, na mangotamwe hele mipalwa kubhehe na kilolo chukunywe mabhele gha uchakaka gha ki uhuke, kupala nkolangane na kukombolelwa,
ngohe, umanye kubhehe Bhambo ndi jwaumbone.
Munnyendelele Bhambo! Jweniojho ndi lighanga lighome lilikanitwe na bhando, nambo lijheketilwe na Chapanga kubhehe lighanga lilihobholeka.

Mangota munnyendelele jwenio ngita maghanga maghome, nchengwite na kubhehe nyumba jha kihuke. Natumika ngita akapiya matambiko gha nyahinyahi, kumpikii matambiko gha kihuke ghijheketelwa na Chapanga kwa ndela jha Yecho Kilichitu.
Nhwalo Majhandiko gha Chapanga ghilonge:

content.text: lighanga lilihaghulilwe lya nchinge na lina ichima.
Mundo jwapala kunhobholela jwenio nakola jhe hone.”

content: Kwino mangota bhimilihobholela lighanga lyenio ndi lya chamane hake, nambo kwa bhangalihobholela lighanga lyenio ngita Majhandiko gha Chapanga chighalonge:

content.text: ngohe lyenio ndi lighanga likolongwa lya nchinge.”

content: Kabhele Majhandiko ghilonge:
Bhando ukobhala nhwalo gwangalihobholela lilobhe lya Chapanga, yenio ndi bhakapangilwe kuhumii makacho.

Nambo mangota ndi bhando lilihaghulilwe, na kubhehe akapiya matambiko na unahota nkolongwa gwa nyahinyahi, kilambo cha nyahinyahi, bhando bha Chapanga jwenio, nhoto kutangacha itendwa ikolongwa ya kukangacha ya jwenio jwankemingine kubhoka mulubhendo na kujhingii mulumule lwake lwa kukangacha.
Makacho mangotamwe makibha mabhando bha Chapanga jhe, nambo ngohe mangota ndi bhando bhake. Makacho mangotamwe makapatite jhe kiya jha Chapanga, nambo ngohe mpatangine kiya jhake.
Ntame ngita akatumiche bha Chapanga
Makalongo bhango, nimpembekeya mangota ngita makaghene na bhapeta ndela pannema pano, nnekane na tama jha yegha jhikanana na uhuke gwino.
Mma na matyangilo ghamaha pakate jha bhando bhangaumanya Chapanga, kupala anda bhakopokii kilebhe changanandela, bhaibhona itendwa hino yamaha bhannumbalila Chapanga lichiko lyaipala kuhika Bhambo.
Majhokanikiya bhando bhubhabhii na ukindendeke bhibhabhekitwe na bhando kwa nhwalo gwa Bhambo: Munahota nkolongwa jwabhii na kindendeke kikolongwa,
amu ilongoche ihaghulilwe na jwenio kwahadabuu bhibhahenga ghanganandela na kalumbalii bhibhahenga ghambone.
Nhwalo Chapanga ipala nhoto kupyata nnomo malobhe gha kimbebhebhe gha bhando bhangabhehe na malango kwa itendwa yambone imuhenga.
Ntamengana ngita bhando bhangatabhwa, nambo gwangatabhwa gwino ukoto kubhehe kijhobhelo cha ubhoho, nambo ntamangana ngita akabhanda bha Chapanga.
Mwatembekeya bhando bhoha, mwapala ajhino bhibhahobholela Kilichitu, munyoghope Chapanga na muntembekeye munahota nkolongwa.
Kulandanikii mang'ahe gha Kilichitu
Mangota makatumiche majhokanikiye akanahota bhino kwa utembekeho ghoha anda bhabhii bhambone amu manuu amu bhina kihokola.
Nhwalo anda nhimbilile mang'ahe ghangatope nhwalo gwa kuntembeke Chapanga, jwenio nampela mota.
Bho, nanyambulila ndweko ghane kwa kuhimbilila kubulwa kwa malemo ghinteile? Nambo anda mibulwa kwa kuhenga ghambone na mmii kuhimbilila gheniya, umanya Chapanga apakumpe mota kwa gheniya ghinteile.
Gheniya ndi ghinkemilwe, nhwalo jwenio Kilichitu akang'ahike kwa nhwalo gwino, nganekela nnandanikiho kupala nkengame ndela jhake.
Jwenio akatei jhe uhakaho, amu akalongii jhe kilebhe chochoha chuwange mu nnomo gwake.
Palighitwa, akabhujhichii jhe, pang'ahika akayengii jhe, nambo ngauhobholila Chapanga jwahadabuu changalolekeya kumiho.
Yecho jwenio ngagheghita uhakaho gwito payegha jhake pa nchalaba, kupala tulekane na uhakaho na kutama muughome kwa mambu ghambone. Kwa ilonda yake mangota nnamite.
Nhwalo mangota mukibha ngita mambelele ghighahobhite, nambo ngohe mumujhii Nnucha na Nnonda jwa ughome gwino.
